objective: 在Phase54未达到绝对10%目标后，使用固定预算的OOF自适应搜索自动探索pure-PD直方图预测候选；搜索可以依据OOF误差和OOF bin bias生成下一轮候选，但不得读取Phase50 blind，不得反复打开validation调参。

dataset_contract.group_isolation: six model rows for one profile stay in the same split and OOF fold
dataset_contract.phase50_blind: not read, not used for candidate generation, and not used for selection
dataset_contract.complete_requests: not read; only compact Phase48 feature/H0/Hfull rows are used

search_contract.adaptation_signal: only OOF absolute score, H0 ratios, model/segment gates and 12-bin signed bias; validation is not opened until all candidates and alpha values are frozen
search_contract.stage_b_policy: for each OOF top candidate, create one deeper/wider variant and one shape/tail variant; prefer per-model scope when OOF model heterogeneity is high
search_contract.candidate_selection: first prefer complete OOF target/protection, then lower absolute four-metric score, then lower calls+bytes histogram WAPE

predictor_contract.implementation: Phase54 deterministic NumPy predictor code pinned by SHA; H0 plus bounded residual; shared or per-model residual heads
predictor_contract.target_representation: encoded log-total plus 12-bin log-share for calls and logical bytes
predictor_contract.h0_protection: one alpha per model, selected only from OOF
predictor_contract.validation_rule: after search and alpha/epoch freeze, fit selected candidate on all 960 train profiles and open the 240 validation profiles exactly once

acceptance_gate.oof_protection: overall and every model strictly beat H0 on calls WAPE, bytes WAPE, calls TV and normalized payload EMD
acceptance_gate.development_formal_target: overall calls histogram WAPE <= 0.10 and bytes histogram WAPE <= 0.10
acceptance_gate.development_model_guard: each of six models has both histogram WAPE <= 0.15
acceptance_gate.development_segment_guard: each BurstGPT segment has both histogram WAPE <= 0.15 and composite ratio < 1
acceptance_gate.total_guard: overall calls total WAPE <= 0.05 and bytes total WAPE <= 0.05
acceptance_gate.phase56_permission: only a complete OOF-protected and validation-passing candidate may authorize a separate blind-freeze/evaluation workflow
acceptance_gate.negative_policy: integrity PASS with target_met=false is valid evidence that the fixed search budget did not reach the contract; it blocks Phase56

stop_and_block_if: any pinned Phase48 or Phase54 source differs
Phase50 blind files or labels are opened
validation profiles are used to generate or rank new candidates
raw or complete request rows are read or written
GPU, network, model download, or original model weights are accessed
claim_boundary: development-only evidence on 1200 Phase48 profiles and six known model structures under pure P1-D1
not fresh blind evidence and not a Phase50 re-evaluation
not physical communication time, placement, latency, queueing, or online scheduling
